text: A wingtip vortex is found during take-off, cruise and landing. When an aircraft flies in ground effect, the ground interferes with the tip vortex, which reduces drag. When the aircraft is flying very near the ground, the vortex strength is much less and therefore there is a large reduction in drag. What's the main topic of the statement?
